$comment: Index for /ops/library — every report and research artifact, in one place. `render` says how the page shows it: `hds` = a native page built on @hirobius/design-system, `legacy` = a standalone HTML file shown framed until it is migrated to HDS. Add an entry when a report lands; migrating one flips `render` from legacy to hds.
